text: Study myths and religions as different languages of describing God. Ancient Greek myths, the Mahabharata, the Gospel, the Quran, the sutras of Buddhism—all these are merely different languages in which the human spirit at different times and in different cultures tried to describe what lies beyond life and death, what fills our existence with higher meaning. Studying each of these languages with interest and respect, you expand your vocabulary, understand that all paths lead in one direction, and find your own path.
